note: Corps of Engineers campground on J. Percy Priest Lake, separate from the Anderson Road day-use area next door, whose swim beach campers may use with their hangtag. The ten electric sites line the north shore behind a band of trees; the non-electric loop is wooded and inland. --Claude
summary: Operating USACE campground (rec.gov 232515 live, not deactivated): $28 non-electric / $40 electric (15/30/50) confirmed, 36 public sites (stored 37; site 36 is management), RV up to 45 ft, 14-night cap per 30 days, showers/flush/dump/water, no wifi. Lakeview confirmed hard: electric pads 2-3 m above summer pool but ~30-40 m back behind a continuous tree band. Season unread (calendar 429).
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview KEPT (checked hard): catalog coordinates put electric sites 01-07 along the north shore of the peninsula, 151.3-152.7 m (3DEP) vs summer pool 149.4 m, but the high-water line (sand/treeline edge in the winter-drawdown imagery) is ~25-40 m from the pads (3DEP transects: the 149.4 m contour lies ~24 m from site 02, ~27 m from 04 and ~42 m from 06, over a gentle ~2 m drop) with a continuous band of evergreens 15-30 m deep between - behind a line of trees, not open ground. Sites 08-10 sit further back; 11-37 are inland under canopy, 100+ m from the west shore. No site qualifies for lakefront; rec.gov carries no Lakefront tags here.
